title: cantilever bracket web too thin: bending margin negative at FoS 0.72
recipe: invert sigma = 6M/(b t^2) for t at the target FoS, round UP to the next 0.01 mm (rounding to nearest can land the repaired part fractionally under target and fail the gate that asked for it), patch web_thickness 3.2 -> 4.61, regenerate, re-run gates

print_settings.orientation: web vertical, foot on the plate — layer lines normal to the bending stress
